summary: Backend-only regression testing for Rafeek Homes after EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY optional fix. Verified server starts (no KeyError), GET /api/ health, POST /api/contact success + persistence via GET /api/inquiries, and 422 validation for invalid email. All 4 pytest cases passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: SMTP credentials are stored in plaintext .env — Gmail app password rejected (535 BadCreds) so every request incurs SMTP timeout latency before Emergent fallback. Consider validating SMTP creds at startup or providing a toggle to disable SMTP path.
POST /api/contact returns 200 for successful create; consider 201 Created for resource creation semantics.
No rate limiting on /api/contact — public endpoint susceptible to spam/abuse.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_-prefixed inquiry via POST /api/contact during persistence test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend-only was requested. All contact/inquiries flows are green. email_sent=true observed via Emergent fallback since Gmail SMTP creds return 535. Frontend not tested per request.
rca of the issue: Original crash: os.environ['EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY'] raised KeyError on user's self-hosted server where the var was absent. Fix at server.py:30 changed to os.environ.get() so backend boots regardless; send_email() now tries SMTP first and only calls send_via_emergent() if EMAIL_KEY is set — otherwise raises RuntimeError caught by /api/contact handler. Confirmed no crash, /api/ returns healthy JSON.
